option_relations.rationale: The option 'Cavernous Sinus Syndrome secondary to lymphoma' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'Secondary central nervous system involvement by systemic CD5+ CD10− B-cell lymphoma (consistent with CLL/SLL) presenting as right cavernous sinus syndrome with thoracic involvement'.

The option 'CD5+ Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma presenting as Cavernous Sinus Syndrome' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'Secondary central nervous system involvement by systemic CD5+ CD10− B-cell lymphoma (consistent with CLL/SLL) presenting as right cavernous sinus syndrome with thoracic involvement'. The leaf specifies 'CD5+ CD10- B-cell lymphoma' which is a more specific type of CD5+ B-cell lymphoma.

The option 'Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (Cavernous sinus involvement)' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'Secondary central nervous system involvement by systemic CD5+ CD10− B-cell lymphoma (consistent with CLL/SLL) presenting as right cavernous sinus syndrome with thoracic involvement', as the latter is a type of Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.

The option 'Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma with CNS involvement' is a broader category that encompasses the specific diagnosis of 'Secondary central nervous system involvement by systemic CD5+ CD10− B-cell lymphoma (consistent with CLL/SLL) presenting as right cavernous sinus syndrome with thoracic involvement', as the latter is a type of B-cell lymphoma with CNS involvement.
